Network Security

Red de Superposición Segura

A logically separated, secured network built on top of an existing network to provide enhanced security controls and isolation, as per NIST SP 800-207 and RFC 6819.

Questions and answers

What is Red de Superposición Segura?

In this glossary, Red de Superposición Segura refers to: A logically separated, secured network built on top of an existing network to provide enhanced security controls and isolation, as per NIST SP 800-207 and RFC 6819.

How is Red de Superposición Segura used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Una red de superposición segura permite a las oficinas remotas conectarse de manera segura a través de Internet pública utilizando túneles cifrados."

Definition
